title: Minimum initial velocity
description: Essential: Correctly calculates v₁ = √(2μgs) ≈ 3.54 m/s using work-energy theorem with kinetic friction.

title: Maximum velocity determination
description: Important: Applies constraint that maximum static friction (2μmg) provides acceleration, and kinetic friction provides deceleration.

title: Acceleration phase analysis
description: Important: Correctly calculates acceleration distance using a = 2μg and v_m² = 2a x₁.

title: Deceleration phase analysis
description: Important: Correctly applies v_m² - v₂² = 2μg(L - x₁) for deceleration under kinetic friction.

title: Total distance constraint
description: Essential: Ensures total distance x₁ + (L - x₁) = 12.5 m, leading to correct v_m and L values.

title: Final numerical values
description: Essential: Reports v_m ≈ 2.89-3 m/s and maximum sliding distance L ≈ 7.33-8.33 m.

title: Confusing friction types
description: Pitfall: Uses kinetic friction coefficient for static friction or vice versa in wrong phase.

title: Missing collision constraint
description: Pitfall: Neglects v₂ < 1.0 m/s condition when calculating maximum velocity.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (m, s, m/s) throughout calculations.
